national.title: How to Apply for Domicile / Residence Certificate in India (2026)
national.summary: Master procedure for obtaining an official Domicile Certificate issued by the Revenue Department. Verified guide covering continuous residency proofs, school study certificates, Talati verification, and digital certificate download.

steps.title: Assemble Continuous Residence Records for Required Period
steps.description: Collect documentary evidence showing continuous physical residence in the state for ten or fifteen years. Acceptable records include consecutive electricity bills, municipal property tax receipts, and ration cards.
steps.where: Applicant Home and Local Utility Offices
steps.calloutText: Proof must show unbroken stay without substantial unexplained gaps across the qualifying ten-year span.

steps.title: Collect School and College Study Certificates
steps.description: Obtain bonafide student certificates or school leaving certificates from institutions attended in the state. School records prove uninterrupted physical presence during childhood and education.
steps.calloutText: School progress reports and leaving certificates serve as strong primary evidence of continuous state residency.

steps.title: Execute Sworn Domicile Affidavit on Stamp Paper
steps.description: Draft a sworn affidavit declaring continuous residence, local address, and absence of domicile in another state. Sign the declaration before a Notary Public or Executive Magistrate on stamp paper.
steps.where: Notary Office or District Court Complex
steps.calloutText: Indian law prohibits holding domicile certificates of two different states simultaneously.

steps.title: Obtain Local Talati or Patwari Inquiry Report
steps.description: Present your residency proofs to your village Talati or ward revenue inspector. The revenue officer conducts field verification of your family stay and issues a signed inquiry report.
steps.where: Gram Panchayat Office or Talati Chamber

steps.title: Submit Online Application on State e-District Portal
steps.description: Register on your state citizen services portal using your mobile number and Aadhaar. Select the Domicile or Residence Certificate service and enter your residential history.
steps.calloutText: Select the taluka or tehsil matching your permanent residence to route the file to the right SDM.

steps.title: Pay Nominal Statutory Service Fee
steps.description: Pay the statutory processing fee of twenty to fifty rupees online using Net Banking, UPI, or debit card. Save the digital payment receipt and application tracking number.
steps.calloutText: Use your application reference number to track file scrutiny across revenue desks.

steps.title: Scrutiny and Approval by Tehsildar or SDM
steps.description: The revenue inspector reviews continuous stay records and verifies absence of conflicting claims. The Sub-Divisional Magistrate or Mamlatdar approves and signs the certificate digitally.

steps.title: Download Digitally Signed Domicile Certificate
steps.description: Download your official certificate from the portal or access it through DigiLocker once approved. The document contains an official government QR code valid for state quota admissions and government jobs.
steps.where: State e-District Portal or DigiLocker App
steps.calloutText: A domicile certificate remains valid permanently unless you change your permanent residence to another state.

rejectionReasons.title: Unexplained Gaps in Continuous Ten-Year Stay Documentation
rejectionReasons.description: Failing to furnish consecutive proofs for every intervening year across the ten-year period causes application suspension.
rejectionReasons.solution: Submit consecutive utility bills, bank statements, or academic records for the missing years.

rejectionReasons.title: Submitting Only Recent Aadhaar Without Historic Residence Proofs
rejectionReasons.description: An Aadhaar card only proves current address, not continuous long-term historical residency.
rejectionReasons.solution: Pair Aadhaar with historic school leaving certificates, registered rent agreements, or utility bills.

rejectionReasons.title: Holding Active Domicile Certificate in Another State
rejectionReasons.description: Citizens can legally claim domicile in only one state at a time. Holding dual domicile leads to cancellation and prosecution.
rejectionReasons.solution: Surrender previous state domicile and submit the formal cancellation endorsement.

rejectionReasons.title: Affidavit on Plain Paper Lacking Official Notary Attestation
rejectionReasons.description: Declarations without official notary stamps, registration numbers, or stamp paper duty are rejected during scrutiny.
rejectionReasons.solution: Execute a fresh declaration on non-judicial stamp paper before an authorized notary.

rejectionReasons.title: Absence of Village Accountant or Talati Field Verification
rejectionReasons.description: Applications submitted without local revenue inquiry reports are rejected during initial scrutiny by the Mamlatdar.
rejectionReasons.solution: Approach your village Talati or municipal ward officer to complete the physical verification report.

rejectionReasons.title: Mismatch Between Stated Birthplace and School Leaving Certificate
rejectionReasons.description: Discrepancies between birthplace in the application and school records raise questions regarding actual origin.
rejectionReasons.solution: Ensure personal details match official school leaving records or birth certificates exactly.

faqItems.question: What is the continuous residence requirement for a Domicile Certificate?
faqItems.answer: Most states including Gujarat require continuous residence for at least ten years. Some states require fifteen years.

faqItems.question: Can an Indian citizen hold Domicile Certificates of two states simultaneously?
faqItems.answer: No. Indian law prohibits dual domicile. You can claim domicile in only one state at any given time.

faqItems.question: What is the difference between a Residence Certificate and a Domicile Certificate?
faqItems.answer: A residence certificate confirms current stay. A domicile certificate confirms permanent legal home and eligibility for state quota benefits.

faqItems.question: Is a Domicile Certificate required for state quota college admissions?
faqItems.answer: Yes. State quota seats in medical and engineering colleges require a valid Domicile Certificate of that state.

faqItems.question: Does a Domicile Certificate have an expiry date?
faqItems.answer: No. Once issued, a Domicile Certificate is permanently valid unless you permanently relocate your domicile to another state.

faqItems.question: Who is the competent issuing authority for Domicile Certificates?
faqItems.answer: The Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Tehsildar, or Taluka Mamlatdar is the statutory issuing authority.

faqItems.question: Can I obtain a Domicile Certificate if I live in rented premises?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Continuous residence can be established using registered rent agreements paired with consecutive electricity bills.

faqItems.question: Does a digitally signed Domicile Certificate need a physical ink stamp?
faqItems.answer: No. Certificates with cryptographic digital signatures and verification QR codes are legally valid without physical ink stamps.

GJ.title: How to Apply for Domicile Certificate in Gujarat (2026)
GJ.summary: Domicile certificates in Gujarat are issued online via Digital Gujarat under the authority of the Taluka Mamlatdar. Learn about the mandatory ten-year continuous stay rule, Talati spot inquiries, and twenty rupee application fees.
GJ.verifiedBy: Civic Research Editorial Team - Gujarat Bureau

steps.title: Register on Digital Gujarat Citizen Portal
steps.description: Log into Digital Gujarat using your mobile number or visit the Jan Seva Kendra at your local taluka Mamlatdar office.
steps.where: Digital Gujarat Portal (digitalgujarat.gov.in) or Jan Seva Kendra

steps.title: Complete 10-Year Continuous Residence Details
steps.description: Enter residential history covering the past ten unbroken years in Gujarat, educational qualifications, and local employment records.
steps.calloutText: Under Gujarat Government rules, applicants must establish at least ten consecutive years of physical residence in the state.

steps.title: Draft Sole Domicile Affidavit on Gujarat Stamp Paper
steps.description: Execute a sworn affidavit declaring sole domicile in Gujarat and confirming you hold no residence certificate from any other Indian state.
steps.calloutText: Indian law prohibits dual domicile. Holding domicile in two states is an offence punishable under revenue codes.

steps.title: Upload Continuous School and Residential Proofs
steps.description: Upload academic marksheet bonafides from Gujarat schools, municipal property tax receipts, electricity bills, and parent domicile records.

steps.title: Talati Spot Inquiry and Neighbor Witness Statements
steps.description: The Talati-cum-Mantri visits your residence, records statements of two local neighbors confirming 10-year stay, and submits the Rojkam report.

steps.title: Download Digitally Signed Domicile Certificate
steps.description: Upon Mamlatdar approval, download your official barcoded certificate. Gujarat domicile certificates carry lifetime validity for education and jobs.
steps.calloutText: The certificate has lifetime validity for Gujarat state quota admissions, government jobs, and agricultural land purchase rights.

fees.label: Gujarat Citizen Charter Processing Fee
fees.description: Prescribed statutory application fee under Gujarat Citizen Charter for domicile certification.

fees.label: Village e-Gram / CSC Facilitation Fee
fees.description: Permitted service fee when applying through village computer centers or Jan Seva Kendras.

faqItems.question: What is the minimum stay required for a Gujarat domicile certificate?
faqItems.answer: Applicants must demonstrate at least ten consecutive years of continuous lawful residence in the State of Gujarat.

faqItems.question: Who is the authorized issuing officer in Gujarat?
faqItems.answer: The Taluka Mamlatdar or Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) in the Revenue Department is the competent issuing authority.

faqItems.question: Can I hold a domicile certificate of Gujarat and another state together?
faqItems.answer: No. Indian legal statutes strictly prohibit holding multiple state domicile certificates simultaneously.

faqItems.question: How long is a Gujarat domicile certificate valid?
faqItems.answer: A Gujarat domicile certificate has lifetime validity unless the individual permanently relocates or renounces Indian citizenship.
